items.title: 61521_David Albert Francis oral history interview
items.q: I think my first party I played was with Bubba Roberts on trumpet, his daughter, Gladys played piano

ctx.x: Well, I got into jazz playing house parties. Yeah. See, they used to have a lot of house parties in Miami, I mean, everybody used to give a party there on a Saturday, and so that was how I got the chance to start playing house parties.
I think my first party I played was with Bubba Roberts on trumpet, his daughter, Gladys played piano, and a guy named, Milton Fletcher -- he was on bass.

items.title: 61521_David Albert Francis oral history interview
items.q: I said, 'Well, I'm a friend of your sister's'

ctx.x: And he also said, that 'His wife taught me in school,' and I said, 'Well, no kidding? Well, how can I get in touch with him?' and he said, 'Well, he's listed in the telephone book'.

So I went to the telephone book, and I called the number, and it just so happened that he was home. So I said to him -- well, I can tell you his name, his name was James McElroy. Mackleroy. So I said, 'Is this Mr. McElroy?' -- and he said, 'Yes', and I said, 'Well, I'm a friend of your sister's' and I didn't want to come out and let him know who I was, as I didn't know if he was gonna get mad or shoot me through the telephone or what.
